title: SSE try_send with warn log: correct for broadcast receiver design
description: The switch from send().await to try_send() in the SSE coalescing task, with a warn log on Full and silent break on Closed, is the right design. The coalescing task holds the broadcast::Receiver. If it blocks on a slow mpsc consumer, it cannot drain the broadcast ring buffer, causing all other SSE clients to see Lagged errors. try_send + drop is the only correct choice. A future contributor may suggest switching back to .await for 'reliability' — reject this. The bounded channel (256) gives plenty of headroom for any realistic JMAP burst; a client that fills it is stalled or disconnected and should be dropped.
